title: How to Spot Fake Silver: Six Tests Every New Buyer Should Know
description: Silver has the highest thermal conductivity of any metal at 429 W/mK. Here are six at-home tests that reliably catch silver-plated fakes, tungsten cores, and wrong-purity coins.
alt: Thermal conductivity chart showing silver at 429 W/mK compared to tungsten at 173 W/mK, with six fake-detection test icons
